info.title: Secret Manager API

requests.name: DELETE /v1beta1/{name}
requests.note: Replace {{SECRET_MANAGER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Gets metadata for a SecretVersion. `projects/*/secrets/*/versions/latest` is an alias to the `latest` SecretVersion.
requests.name: GET /v1beta1/{name}
requests.note: Replace {{SECRET_MANAGER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Updates metadata of an existing Secret.
requests.name: PATCH /v1beta1/{name}
requests.note: Replace {{SECRET_MANAGER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Lists information about the supported locations for this service.
requests.name: GET /v1beta1/{name}/locations
requests.note: Replace {{SECRET_MANAGER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Accesses a SecretVersion. This call returns the secret data. `projects/*/secrets/*/versions/latest` is an alias to the `latest` SecretVersion.
requests.name: GET /v1beta1/{name}:access
requests.note: Replace {{SECRET_MANAGER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Destroys a SecretVersion. Sets the state of the SecretVersion to DESTROYED and irrevocably destroys the secret data.
requests.name: POST /v1beta1/{name}:destroy
requests.note: Replace {{SECRET_MANAGER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Disables a SecretVersion. Sets the state of the SecretVersion to DISABLED.
requests.name: POST /v1beta1/{name}:disable
requests.note: Replace {{SECRET_MANAGER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Enables a SecretVersion. Sets the state of the SecretVersion to ENABLED.
requests.name: POST /v1beta1/{name}:enable
requests.note: Replace {{SECRET_MANAGER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.name: GET /v1beta1/{parent}/secrets
requests.note: Replace {{SECRET_MANAGER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Creates a new Secret containing no SecretVersions.
requests.name: POST /v1beta1/{parent}/secrets
requests.note: Replace {{SECRET_MANAGER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Lists SecretVersions. This call does not return secret data.
requests.name: GET /v1beta1/{parent}/versions
requests.note: Replace {{SECRET_MANAGER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Creates a new SecretVersion containing secret data and attaches it to an existing Secret.
requests.name: POST /v1beta1/{parent}:addVersion
requests.note: Replace {{SECRET_MANAGER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Gets the access control policy for a secret. Returns empty policy if the secret exists and does not have a policy set.
requests.name: GET /v1beta1/{resource}:getIamPolicy
requests.note: Replace {{SECRET_MANAGER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Sets the access control policy on the specified secret. Replaces any existing policy. Permissions on SecretVersions are enforced according to the policy set on the associated Secret.
requests.name: POST /v1beta1/{resource}:setIamPolicy
requests.note: Replace {{SECRET_MANAGER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Returns permissions that a caller has for the specified secret. If the secret does not exist, this call returns an empty set of permissions, not a NOT_FOUND error. Note: This operation is designed to be used for building permission-aware UIs and command-line tools, not for authorization checking. This operation may "fail open" without warning.
requests.name: POST /v1beta1/{resource}:testIamPermissions
requests.note: Replace {{SECRET_MANAGER_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
